title: Host guided setup, administrator setup and first library
journey: Local provisioning is under test; verify server readiness and first library without requiring ordinary users to configure PostgreSQL, DATABASE_URL, service units or reverse proxy; leave undecided implementation choices open.

platform.desktop_session: required for graphical desktop journeys; otherwise not applicable

preconditions: Disposable dedicated acceptance identity and scenario-owned state.
No prior Synveil installation, package registration, installer-owned integration or stale acceptance state unless a declared upgrade/recovery source is required.
A brand-new OS and removal of unrelated user files are not required.

steps.description: Launch through the supported installed entrypoint.
Complete the guided local Host setup.
Create exactly one owner through the PostgreSQL-authoritative local product flow, then explicitly authenticate; Prompt036 still owns whole-journey acceptance.
Choose or create the authorized library.

assertions.description: Guided Host setup reports the local server ready only after its readiness checks.
The first library is ready after administrator setup.
Ordinary Host flow does not require manual PostgreSQL, DATABASE_URL, unit-file or reverse-proxy configuration.

forbidden_outcomes.description: Installer lifecycle deletes user library content.
Credential value is written to ordinary config or diagnostics.
Unknown or newer schema is reset or downgraded.
Persistent startup is enabled without explicit user consent.
Desktop control is exposed through a public TCP/HTTP listener.
An ambiguous mutation is blindly replayed without authoritative reconciliation.
Installation is reported complete before payload, integration and launch verification.
